name: Shinozaki Hazuki
source: Has been Reiji's friend since childhood. She is a very straight-forward girl in all matters except her heart. She has been in love with Reiji for a long time, ever since he was there for her when her parents died. But she cannot seem to tell him how she feels, and her frustration about this tends to lead to unintended fights.
